const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboPaint eai-standard/2.2 episode driver for copying 月."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+Q_DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=float)
+SHEET_MM = 227.185
+PX_MM = SHEET_MM / 1024.0
+PAPER_Z = 0.020
+
+
+def paper_to_world(u: float, v: float, z: float) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Map target image coordinates (pixel centres) to world xyz."""
+    X = (u + 0.5) * PX_MM / 1000.0  # robot-right = -world y
+    Y = (v + 0.5) * PX_MM / 1000.0  # toward robot = -world x
+    return np.array([0.0135925 - Y, 0.1135925 - X, z], dtype=float)
+
+
+def interpolate_poses(start, end, max_step=0.009):
+    start, end = np.asarray(start, float), np.asarray(end, float)
+    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(end[:3] - start[:3]) / max_step)))
+    rows = []
+    for t in np.linspace(1 / n, 1, n):
+        p = start + t * (end - start)
+        rows.append(p)
+    return np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def move_tip(r: Robot, xyz, *, q=Q_DOWN, max_step=0.009, video="none", cameras=None):
+    now = np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[]).meta["proprio"]["now"], float)
+    start = np.r_[now[7:10], now[10:14]]
+    end = np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, float), np.asarray(q, float)]
+    # Keep the brush vertical; interpolate the translational path at the 20 Hz rate.
+    actions = interpolate_poses(start, end, max_step=max_step)
+    return r.submit("ee_pose", actions, dt=0.05, video=video, cameras=cameras)
+
+
+def paper_stroke(r: Robot, pixels, *, z=PAPER_Z - 0.006, max_step=0.005,
+                 cameras=None, video="mp4", note="main sheet stroke"):
+    """Execute one polyline as one continuous main-sheet contact."""
+    points = [paper_to_world(u, v, z) for u, v in pixels]
+    now = np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[]).meta["proprio"]["now"], float)
+    cur = np.r_[now[7:10], now[10:14]]
+    chunks = []
+    for p in points:
+        end = np.r_[p, Q_DOWN]
+        chunks.append(interpolate_poses(cur, end, max_step=max_step))
+        cur = end
+    actions = np.concatenate(chunks, axis=0)
+    if len(actions) > 400:
+        raise ValueError(f"stroke has {len(actions)} rows (limit 400)")
+    return r.submit("ee_pose", actions, dt=0.05, video=video, cameras=cameras, note=note)
+
+
+def dip(r: Robot, xyz, *, z_surface=0.0):
+    """Lower vertically into ink, then lift clear; callers supply the well centre."""
+    move_tip(r, [xyz[0], xyz[1], z_surface + 0.025], video="none")
+    move_tip(r, [xyz[0], xyz[1], z_surface - 0.004], video="mp4")
+    move_tip(r, [xyz[0], xyz[1], z_surface + 0.06], video="none")
+
+
+def status(r: Robot):
+    return r.status()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    # The live episode is driven in staged calls so each result can be inspected.
+    r = Robot()
+    print(r.status())
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
text(r);

+def paper_stroke(r: Robot, pixels, *, depth=0.008, max_step=0.0025,
+                 cameras=None, video="mp4", note="main sheet stroke"):
+    """Execute one polyline as one continuous main-sheet contact.
+
+    Each path entry is (u,v) or (u,v,press_depth_m), where depth is how far
+    the unbent tip is below the paper surface. Approach above the path start,
+    lower vertically, trace, then lift vertically at the endpoint.
+    """
+    points = []
+    for item in pixels:
+        u, v = item[:2]
+        d = float(item[2]) if len(item) > 2 else float(depth)
+        p = paper_to_world(u, v, PAPER_Z - d)
+        points.append(np.r_[p, Q_DOWN])
+    if len(points) < 2:
+        raise ValueError("a stroke needs at least two points")
+    start, end = points[0], points[-1]
+    move_tip(r, [start[0], start[1], PAPER_Z + 0.055], video="none")
+    # A slow vertical entry keeps the first contact at the intended stroke head.
+    move_tip(r, start[:3], max_step=0.0015, video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[]).meta["proprio"]["now"], float)
+    cur = np.r_[now[7:10], now[10:14]]

"""RoboPaint eai-standard/2.2 episode driver for copying 月."""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

Q_DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=float)
SHEET_MM = 227.185
PX_MM = SHEET_MM / 1024.0
PAPER_Z = 0.020
INK_WELL = (-0.100, 0.150)
INK_SURFACE_Z = 0.0285
PRACTICE_CENTER = (-0.100, -0.1856)
PRACTICE_Z = 0.020


def paper_to_world(u: float, v: float, z: float) -> np.ndarray:
    """Map target image coordinates (pixel centres) to world xyz."""
    X = (u + 0.5) * PX_MM / 1000.0  # robot-right = -world y
    Y = (v + 0.5) * PX_MM / 1000.0  # toward robot = -world x
    return np.array([0.0135925 - Y, 0.1135925 - X, z], dtype=float)


def interpolate_poses(start, end, max_step=0.009):
    start, end = np.asarray(start, float), np.asarray(end, float)
    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(end[:3] - start[:3]) / max_step)))
    rows = []
    for t in np.linspace(1 / n, 1, n):
        p = start + t * (end - start)
        rows.append(p)
    return np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32)


def move_tip(r: Robot, xyz, *, q=Q_DOWN, max_step=0.009, video="none", cameras=None):
    now = np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[]).meta["proprio"]["now"], float)
    start = np.r_[now[7:10], now[10:14]]
    end = np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, float), np.asarray(q, float)]
    # Keep the brush vertical; interpolate the translational path at the 20 Hz rate.
    actions = interpolate_poses(start, end, max_step=max_step)
    return r.submit("ee_pose", actions, dt=0.05, video=video, cameras=cameras)
